hooks.expectedPayoff: What Margaret Lyle owes Silas Venn, and what he knows about the altar silver
hooks.notes: Venn demands forty pounds and threatens to tell the vicar (ch1); Margaret explains the altar silver (ch4).

hooks.expectedPayoff: Whether Nell Ashby will go to the harvest dance with Tom Hale
hooks.notes: Tom asks; Nell says to ask again on Friday (ch1); she says yes, and they are engaged (ch4).
Venn is found dead of foxglove (ch2); Nell sees the cut border (ch3); Margaret Lyle confesses (ch4).

hooks.expectedPayoff: Whose is the green glass bottle broken in Venn's grate
hooks.notes: Tom finds the pieces (ch2); Margaret's basket is without it (ch3); she says she carried the tincture in it (ch4).
